title: Isandro and the Cover
author: Jonah Underhill
blurb: Mirabel Thackeray, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
